blocks.prompt: 10 A sum of Rs. 5000 becomes 6324.48 when invested at 8% per annum, compounded annually. Find the time \(t\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh compound interest ka ulta sawal hai: aakhri raqam di hui hai aur waqt poocha hai.
Diya kya hai? \(P = 5000\), \(A = 6324.48\), rate 8% saalana, compounded annually (\(n = 1\)).
Find kya karna hai? Waqt \(t\), jo \((1.08)^{t}\) ki power mein hai.
Rule kaunsa? Power mein unknown ho to dono taraf logarithm lete hain aur \(\ln(a^{t}) = t\ln a\) se \(t\) neeche aata hai.
Plan: 5000 se divide kar ke power ko akela karna, \(\ln\) lena, aur \(\ln 1.08\) se divide karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P = 5000\), \(A = 6324.48\), \(r = 0.08\), \(n = 1\).
Maloom karna: waqt \(t\) (saal).
Tareeqa: \(n = 1\) par formula \(A = P(1 + r)^{t}\) ban jata hai. \(t\) power mein hai, is liye logarithm lenge. Is dafa base \(e\) nahi, 1.08 hai, is liye power law \(\ln(a^{t}) = t\ln a\) kaam aayega.

Power ko akela karein
\[(1.08)^{t} = \dfrac{6324.48}{5000}\]
\[= 1.264896\]
Kyun: dono taraf 5000 se divide kiya. Ab sirf power wala hissa ek taraf hai.

Dono taraf \(\ln\) lein
\[t\ln(1.08) = \ln(1.264896)\]
Kyun: power law \(\ln(a^{t}) = t\ln a\). Isi se \(t\) power se utar kar multiply ki shakal mein aa gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(\ln(1.08)^{t}\) ko \(\ln(1.08 t)\) mat samjhiye; power poore 1.08 par hai.

\(t\) nikaalein
\[t = \dfrac{\ln(1.264896)}{\ln(1.08)}\]
\[= \dfrac{0.234990}{0.076961}\]
\[\approx 3.05\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(\ln 1.08\) se divide kiya. Agar \(\log\) (base 10) lein to bhi yahi jawab aata hai, bas upar neeche ek hi base ho.

Tasdeeq
\[5000(1.08)^{3.05} \approx 6322.8\]
\[\approx 6324.48\]
Kyun: thora sa farq sirf \(t\) ko 3.05 tak round karne ki wajah se hai. Ghor kijiye: poore 3 saal mein raqam \(5000(1.08)^{3} = 6298.56\) hoti, 6324.48 nahi. Is liye sahi jawab 3.05 saal hai, jo taqreeban 3 saal banta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(t \approx 3\) saal likha hai. Yeh sirf poore saal tak round ki hui value hai: di hui values se \(t = \frac{\ln 1.264896}{\ln 1.08} \approx 3.05\) saal banta hai. Bilkul 3 saal mein raqam \(5000(1.08)^{3} =\) Rs. 6298.56 hoti, Rs. 6324.48 nahi. Is liye jawab 3.05 saal likhiye (taqreeban 3 saal).
